      Roundsys

      Software Developer

      Mangalore
      ₹7L (Employer provided)

      About the Role:

      We’re looking for a skilled and thoughtful Software Developer who takes pride in writing clean, scalable code and enjoys working closely with a team in a fast-paced, in-person environment to join us on our mission to create a meaningful impact on the UK Social Care sector.

      You’ll play a key role in designing and building functionality to directly improve the quality of care to vulnerable people around the UK. Attention to detail and a sense of ownership are essential.

      What we do:

      RoundSys is a leader in care software. We are recognised as an innovation leader and our system helps provide quality care for vulnerable individuals across the UK.

      We provide a simple-to-use app for carers and managers to ensure consistent, high-quality care is delivered, all the while removing the need for paperwork.

      Find us at

      What you’ll be doing:

      • Designing and developing robust, maintainable applications using JavaScript and SQL
      • Writing clean, scalable code that stands the test of time
      • Putting simplicity at the forefront
      • Collaborating with designers to ensure UI/UX concepts are practical and implementable
      • Optimising front-end and back-end performance
      • Taking ownership of your code by testing it before it is deployed to our dedicated testing squad
      • Contributing to architectural decisions and evolving existing systems
      • Working closely with a close-knit international English-speaking team across the full development lifecycle

      What we’re looking for:

      We’re particularly interested in candidates who are intentional about their work and can demonstrate strong fundamentals.

      • 3+ years of relevant professional experience is essential.
      • Strong proficiency in core JavaScript
      • Solid hands-on experience with SQL
      • Ability to write code that is well-structured and maintainable
      • A problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
      • Confidence working in a collaborative, in-person team environment
      • Experience working on SaaS platforms or social care systems
      • Exposure to data-driven applications
      • An interest in building products that have a real impact

      What it takes:

      • Stay ambitious - constantly push yourself to grow, learn, and raise the bar
      • Be a driver of positive team culture, collaborating with a team that are proud and excited to be a part of RoundSys
      • The ability to embrace challenges and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
      • Practise precise, proactive communication, leading alignment and momentum
      • Anticipate problems, take initiative, and make things happen

      We’re looking for candidates who are genuinely interested in what we do and can clearly demonstrate their experience.

      The basics:

      • Office based in Mangalore
      • Working days: Mon - Fri, 9:00am - 5:30pm IST
      • Smart Casual dress
      • Full-time

      Job Type: Full-time

      Pay: ₹700,000.00 per year

      Application Question(s):

      • “In a few sentences, tell us what interests you about what we do and how you could contribute to our development team”

      Experience:

      • Software development: 2 years (Required)

      Language:

      • Fluent English (Required)

      Work Location: In person

      Base pay

      The minimum salary is ₹7L and the max salary is ₹7L.
      ₹7L/yr (Employer provided)
